t: Burning pictures onto optical discs, then adding Fourier optics
d: DiscImageStudio converts an image into disc data, so that after burning, the picture is visible on the surface of a CD, DVD or single-layer Blu-ray. A disc is also a diffraction grating. I want to shine a laser on a burned pattern and see what it projects, and then try the reverse: design the pattern to burn from the Fourier transform of the image I want to see.
